# Infinite Red — account brief

## Who
Infinite Red is a consultancy specializing in React Native app design and development ([source](https://infinitered.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the site infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is committed in infinitered/ignite ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)).
- infinitered/ignite runs react-native 0.74.5 in package.json ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under .github/workflows ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 150 public repos and 2100 followers ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).
- infinitered/ignite last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)).
- The homepage links a careers page ([source](https://infinitered.com/careers)). No job listing or role was observed behind it.

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@infinitered-maintainer-1), 310 commits to infinitered/ignite, profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@infinitered-maintainer-2), 188 commits to infinitered/ignite, profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@infinitered-maintainer-3), 97 commits to infinitered/ignite, profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-3)).

The evidence gives no title or role for any of the three. Location and bio are not in the records.

## Why now
infinitered/ignite last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)) and is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)). No store listing or release cadence is in the evidence, so how often client apps ship is unknown.

## Suggested opener
You have 310 commits in infinitered/ignite ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)), and it ships with an eas.json ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside CI workflows in .github/workflows ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 and was last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)). When a team starts from Ignite, does the eas.json in the template stay as the build config they run, or do your CI workflows take over the build and submit steps from there?
